analyst_observations: The skill achieves 100% pass rate across all 3 evals vs 37.5% baseline — a +62.5pp improvement.

The biggest discriminating assertions are: probability-weighted scenarios (0% baseline → 100% skill), EV calculations (0% → 100%), and position sizing guidance (0% → 100%). These are the skill's core value-add.
Real-time data fetching and source citations pass in both conditions — Claude already does this well without the skill. These are non-discriminating assertions.
The skill costs ~60% more tokens and time. This is expected: it runs 7 analysis modules with parallel web searches. The quality improvement justifies the cost for investment analysis.

The baseline multi-stock report (eval-1) picked GOOG as the best play; the skill picked MSFT. Both used real data but reached different conclusions because the skill's EV framework penalized META's legal risk more heavily.
The skill's 'Hidden Opportunities' section consistently delivers value — surface-level analysis misses these entirely.
